issue.title: Merged Pomodoros: merge by default, split and merge by type, honest close names
issue.description: A Pomodoro that holds several task types is a first-class merged Pomodoro. Linking or moving a task into another type's Pomodoro merges that type into the name instead of retyping the task. Capture `=*` and `=/` merge and split Pomodoros by type, and so does Obsidian Ctrl+S. `x` names the closed and carried sessions after the work that was actually done and is still planned. bob-cli, bob-plugins, and Bob Mac Capture all agree, through shared vectors.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (from the bob-cli-f9 land agent): on master 675330dd, `just check` fails 5 tests in `-p bob-obsidian --test cli`: capture::pomodoro_link::capture_named_pomodoro_updates_both_notes_and_skips_current, capture::pomodoro_link::capture_named_pomodoro_dry_run_and_failures_leave_notes_untouched, capture::project_note::capture_project_note_task_links_write_the_worked_example, capture::project_note_offer::offer_named_pomodoro_is_created_only_when_a_pick_lands_there, capture::task_theme_writes::named_capture_writes_a_type_without_a_shown_suggestion. Each expects an untyped task linked into a named Pomodoro to gain [type:: <NAME>] (e.g. expected '- [*] #task Some foobar task. [type:: BUGS] ...', got no type field). Cause: 675330dd (bob-cli-fe.1) replaced routing::retype with routing::land; land() returns LandOutcome::Consistent as soon as effective_key is None (src/native/pomodoro_themes/routing.rs:131), whereas the old retype() only short-circuited when an effective key matched and otherwise fell through to choose/Set the destination type. Callers in src/native/capture/task_theme.rs and src/native/capture_pomodoro_name.rs pass retype: true, so typeless tasks no longer get typed on landing. Either restore the typeless fall-through in land() or update the five tests if dropping the write is intended by the merged-Pomodoro contract; fe.2 (capture-link-merge) looks like the natural owner.
